sayLines.text: Marcus leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Lockpick. Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Lockpick: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

A storm is coming, and it does not care about your plans. Be at Haven by dusk — sheltering costs the dusk foraging window (400–800 kcal you'll never see). Getting caught out costs more.

"...A LEDGER," it repeats. "PROOF OF WORTH." A long, long quiet. "I HAVE NEVER BEEN WORTH ANYONE'S NOISE," it says, and the worst part is it sounds almost hopeful — asking. "WOULD YOU — IF I — " It stops itself. "NOTED. THE GRIEF STAYS WITH THE PEOPLE. ...THANK YOU FOR NOT LETTING ME STEAL IT."
